name: Reign of Heroes - TABLETOP MOBA VR
summary:
YOUR FRIENDS. YOUR HEROES. EPIC BATTLES.

Your friend charges in. You follow up with your ultimate. A tower falls and victory is within reach. Reign of Heroes brings the thrill of a MOBA to a colorful cartoon battlefield, right in front of you in virtual reality.

TEAM UP OR CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
Each player controls a hero in teams of 6. Face other players or join forces against AI. You don’t need a full group of 12: start multiplayer with just two players and let AI heroes fill the remaining slots. Pract
